entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's the VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your full name and order number?
Of course. It's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF785-9912.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order here, delivered on December 15th. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything... it's just not what I expected. I find it a bit bulky, and I'm not really using it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was just really hoping I could get my money back. Things are a little tight right now.
I completely understand, and I appreciate you sharing that with me. It's important that you're happy with your purchase. Let me just review the return policy for your order, one moment.
Alright, Sarah, thank you for your patience. I've checked the information here, and according to our company policy, your VeloBand is still well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So it's not too late? That's such a relief.

Not at all. I am processing the return for you right now. I've just sent an email to you with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund in 3 to 5 business days.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea how much I appreciate this. You've been a huge help.
You are very welcome, Sarah. We value your business. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
